Select approved drugs with phase 4 status for the indication 'acute myeloid leukemia'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication and filter by mesh_heading. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN compound_structures), efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
